milestone: v0.1.0 (Windows-only, release candidate on branch dev)
current_task: Prepare v0.1.0 on the dev integration branch: manifests that a real browser loads, localized context menu, link-click routing with browser fallback, CI-first validation, and a release report that separates what was executed from what needs a real machine.

workflow.local_builds_reason: Smart App Control holds newly linked binaries on this developer machine, so cargo build/test and npm build are not run locally for this release.
workflow.push_policy: push origin dev only; master, tags and GitHub releases are owner-only
workflow.watch: gh run watch; failures read with gh run view --log-failed

toolchain.local_runtime: not used for validation in this release
toolchain.msvc_status: Windows SDK 10.0.26100 later found installed locally (kernel32.lib present under Windows Kits\10\Lib\10.0.26100.0\um\x64), but local production builds remain out of scope for this release per the owner's workflow.

release_artefacts.built_locally_before_workflow_change: releases/ (gitignored) contained NSIS exe 3051643 B, MSI 4419584 B, source zip 1476048 B and SHA256SUMS.txt from a real MSVC run; those files are not tracked and are not the deliverable of this branch.
release_artefacts.ci_source: release.yml builds the same four artefacts on a GitHub runner (triggered by dev pushes, tags, or manual dispatch) and uploads them as workflow artefacts.

what_needs_a_real_machine: Installing SAYL-Setup-x64-0.1.0.exe and completing the uninstall.

Opening the desktop window at all: this session's token is Low Mandatory Level, Chromium's Mojo CreateNamedPipeW fails with Access denied and msedgewebview2.exe dies, so no GUI window and no real UI screenshot can be produced here.
The four locale/theme screenshots of the real window (Arabic light, Arabic dark, English light, English dark).
The in-app download journey: pause, resume, cancel, save-folder picker, drag and drop, and relaunch mid-download.
Loading the unpacked extension into Chrome or Edge, registering the native host with the real extension id, and watching a link and a context-menu click arrive in the running app.

defects_fixed.description: The manifest declared no default_locale and no _locales, so chrome.i18n had no strings and the extension could not be localized.
defects_fixed.fix: Declared default_locale ar, added _locales/ar and _locales/en, and moved name, description and action title to __MSG_ placeholders.
defects_fixed.test: CI validates both messages.json files as JSON

defects_fixed.description: The context menu title was hard-coded Arabic only; it must read 'التحميل باستخدام سيل' in Arabic and 'Download with Sayl' in English.
defects_fixed.fix: Menu title now comes from chrome.i18n (context_menu_download) with both locales present.
defects_fixed.test: tools/e2e/browser-extension-test.mjs loads background.js against recording stubs and asserts the created menu title

defects_fixed.description: The extension had no link-click handler, so clicking a download link never reached SAYL.
defects_fixed.fix: Registered a main-frame content script that intercepts http(s) link clicks and hands them to the background worker, and documented that SAYL is only used when the native host answers.
defects_fixed.test: tools/e2e/browser-extension-test.mjs compares the clicked URL with the bridge queue

next_task: Push the dev branch, watch CI and the release workflow, fix failures from gh run view --log-failed, and fill docs/TEST-REPORT-V0.1.0.md with the CI evidence plus the list of runtime checks that need a real desktop machine.
notes: The local install and fixture download that earlier rounds performed were engine/CLI level and are reported in docs/TEST-REPORT-V0.1.0.md as such; they do not stand in for the GUI or browser journeys.
